# Individuality as zero information inflow — numbers (generated by biology/individuality.py; do not edit)

Every number below is computed from `results/biology/individuality/per_replicator.csv` (this analysis; columns named in each table) unless a source is given in the heading. Inputs: `results/stageG/stageG/stage_g_runs.csv` (Z80 first/final tapes, `*_has_cf`, `*_has_block`, `*_copied`, `*_damaged`) and `results/bff/runs.csv` with `runs/bff_modal/bff/<run>/cond.json` (BFF tapes, `*_copies`, `*_self_damage`, `*_loop`, executor flags). Partner test: 256 uniformly random partners per replicator (numpy default_rng, seed per replicator in column `partner_seed`), organism in the first half, one encounter (Z80: 128 instructions, `algocell_exp.assay.execute_pairs`; BFF: the soup's own flags and steps, `micro.bff.BFF`). H = plug-in entropy in bits of the 256 offspring strings (maximum log2(256) = 8 bits; a replicator whose offspring are all distinct sits at the ceiling, so H is a lower bound there). Under determinism I(O; E | X) = H(O | X) − H(O | X, E) = H(O | X).

- BFF soups in runs.csv: 84; life-producing (t_top not null): 64 (std 9, wrap 19, lit 12, wraplit 12, wraplitnh 12); the 20 soups without a replicator have no first tape and are not part of the analysis.
